# DORADO (CSOAI Ltd, Council of AI)

Independent AI-governance **measurement** body. A signed score layer over the RFC 9943 substrate (RFC 9942 receipts). **Measurement, never certification** — a measurement card is NOT a certification, endorsement, or conformity mark.

- Legal: CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677. did:web:csoai.org.
- Neutrality: the scored entity never pays for its measurement; a vendor can buy the data, never the score.
- Code: Apache-2.0 · Spec text: CSL-1.0.

## What this produces

A **signed measurement card** + **SCITT receipt (RFC 9943)** + **RFC 3161 external time-anchor** over a deterministic GSPC measurement. One engine, many domain axis-registries.

## Domains (axis registries)

- Generic governance: `csoai.gspc-16` (16 axes)
- Bond: `csoai.gspc-domains/bond/1.0` (6 axes)
- Bank: `csoai.gspc-domains/bank/1.0` (6 axes)
- Insurance: `csoai.gspc-domains/insurance/1.0` (6 axes)
- Equity: `csoai.gspc-domains/equity/1.0` (6 axes)
- Index: `csoai.gspc-domains/index/1.0` (6 axes)
- Cross-border / east-to-east: `csoai.gspc-domains/cross-border/1.0` (6 axes)

## CLI usage (humans)

```bash
dorado domains                          # list registries
dorado measure  --model X --domain bond --card card.json --out axis.json
dorado sign     --card card.json                         # Ed25519 COSE_Sign1
dorado receipt  --card card.json --out receipt.json      # SCITT RFC 9943
dorado anchor   --card card.json --out anchor.json       # RFC 3161 TSA
dorado verify   --card card.json --pubkey <b64>          # stranger-verify
dorado verify-receipt   --receipt receipt.json --card card.json
dorado verify-anchor    --anchor anchor.json  --card card.json
dorado verify-all       --card card.json [--receipt r.json] [--anchor a.json]
dorado export   --in axis.json --out-dir data-out        # licensable data product
dorado crosswalk [--domain bond]                         # provision citations
dorado selfcheck                                         # hermetic tests
dorado license  --licensee X --dataset-id D --price-gbp 5000 --out manifest.json
```

A stranger verifies with only the published Ed25519 key + `cryptography` (anchor also needs `pip install asn1crypto`).

## The measurement board

The DORADO measurement **board** (the body's record of what it measured) is a
content-addressed, append-only registry at `board/board-index.json` — fetch it as
`https://csoai-org.github.io/dorado/board/board-index.json`. It is a MEASUREMENT
registry, not a rank table. Each entry records a signed card's content hash,
registry, subject, measured/total, kid, receipt content_id, anchor time, and
provision-axis count, with `chainOk` / `linked` diagnostics.

```bash
dorado publish --card card.json [--receipt r.json] [--anchor a.json]   # append (dedupe)
dorado board [--json]                                                 # show the index
```

## Verification (free, public)

- `dorado verify` → checks the Ed25519 signature (tamper-detect) + optional identity pinning.
- `dorado verify-receipt` → checks content_id + binds the receipt to a specific card.
- `dorado verify-anchor` → checks the RFC 3161 TSA MessageImprint matches this card's digest (external time-binding).

## A2A agents

See `agent/agent.json` (A2A agent card) and `a2a.md` for the exact contract. An agent calls `dorado.verify*` tools to independently check a measurement — it never has to trust a self-reported number.

## Files

- `schemas/measurement-card.schema.json` — the card schema.
- `draft/draft-csoai-scitt-measurement-card-00.md` — the RFC draft.
- `engine/`, `harness/`, `cli/`, `axes/`, `test/` — implementation.
- `GOVERNANCE.md` — doctrine (two heads, one neutral substrate, neutrality, anti-capture).

## Register (verbatim)

> "This is a measurement credential. It is not a certification, endorsement, or conformity mark, and must not be presented as one."
